subject.title: [Bug]: Notarized macOS app auto-terminates ~0.5s after launch (no menu-bar icon) in remote mode — macOS 26

question: Can a maintainer reproduce the clean AppKit automatic-termination exit with v2026.6.11 or current-main notarized macOS 26 remote mode, and which boundary owns the fix if it reproduces?
rationale: The report is detailed and current code still matches the implicated path, but the fix boundary depends on notarized package behavior that this read-only Linux review cannot verify safely.

options.title: Run notarized macOS 26 repro
options.body: Reproduce with the latest official macOS app or a current-main notarized package, collect unified logs around launch, and scope the fix only after the boundary is known.

options.title: Close only after non-repro proof
options.body: Close as cannot-reproduce only if a comparable notarized macOS 26 remote-mode setup stays resident with a visible menu-bar item and matching logs are attached.

options.title: Route only confirmed leftovers
options.body: If the app now stays resident but remote diagnostics or stale tunnel behavior remains, link the remaining work to the broader macOS remote Gateway UX thread instead of treating this issue as fixed.

recommendation.title: Run notarized macOS 26 repro
recommendation.body: Reproduce with the latest official macOS app or a current-main notarized package, collect unified logs around launch, and scope the fix only after the boundary is known.
